subject: physics
title: Давление в закрытом сосуде
statement: A closed vessel with volume $V_0 = 10$ l contains dry air in the normal conditions ($t_0 = 0$°C, $p_0 = 1$ atm). In some moment 3 g of water were added to the vessel and the system was warmed up to $t = 100$°C. Find the pressure in the vessel. Discuss assumption you made to solve the problem.
